name: No Longer Required
storyline:
In a dystopian city, an ordinary café worker spends their days serving customers and following the same repetitive routine.

But strange things begin to happen after closing time. As the nights grow increasingly unsettling, monitoring the café through security cameras becomes essential to staying safe.

Something is wrong with this city, and the truth may be far more disturbing than it first appears.
summary:
No Longer Required is a short, PS1-inspired psychological horror game that blends coffee shop simulation with nighttime survival.

By day, players work as a barista, preparing drinks, following recipes, and serving customers in a dystopian city. By night, the familiar routine gives way to unsettling events, security camera surveillance, and an increasingly dangerous struggle to survive. What begins as an ordinary job gradually becomes something far more disturbing.
